svg.title: PARMAR desktop experience reference collection
svg.desc: Ten desktop screen design references for implemented PARMAR features. The canonical VOKKI portrait is used from the approved project asset. The original PARMAR knot-and-wordmark crops come directly from Logo.jpg.
svg.text: A spacious, human-governed AI workspace across real product capabilities
Interface specifications reflect existing routes. Canonical VOKKI art restored; standalone logo source still required.

g.text: PARMAR is here to help you think, plan, create and review.
Recent activity and conversation previews are rendered from loaded user data only.
No invented usage counters, active tasks or external provider status.
What would you like to think through?
Released responses are shown only after the
configured provider and PARMAR safety checks.
Rich text / code formatting / validated research
What would you like to think through?
Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line · Research optional
Presentation and conversation remain separate from authorization.
VOKKI communicates the result of an existing review.
On-device recognition, browser dependent; no cloud fallback.
Optional; only released responses may be spoken.
What would you like PARMAR to consider?
Available and unavailable capabilities are clearly separated.
Risk, safety, enforcement and approval flow.
Local synthetic scenarios, no real actions.
No upload or document-analysis route exists.
Registry metadata only; no execution route.
No account connection surface is present.
No live news provider is configured.
No disabled capability is represented as available.
Search saved research in loaded conversations...
Only research records present in loaded conversation history appear here.
A research result is stored with its actual conversation and validated sources.
No search runs until you request it in Chat.
Provider availability is configuration metadata, not a reachability guarantee.
External requests remain subject to PARMAR authorization and safety checks.
Search loaded conversations, memories and activity...
Open a saved conversation to continue its original context.
Context menus and record actions remain tied to existing behavior.
Empty, loading and storage errors are explicit.
Local demo history is not merged into authenticated records.
Search covers loaded data only; it does not claim access to an unconfigured account.
Rename and delete remain available only where the existing flow supports them.
Search settings, language, appearance, voice and privacy...
Appearance, motion and request language are local preferences.
They do not alter PARMAR's safety decisions or provider configuration.
Keyboard focus, readable contrast and reduced motion are respected.
Review a real proposal and decide whether it may proceed.
No proposal is approved automatically. Authorization does not claim execution.
A real proposal and its review evidence appear here when available.
Approve / Reject actions are only shown for an actual pending proposal.
Missing risk data is reported as unavailable, not assumed safe.
Pipeline stages and reasoning are backend-reported, never fabricated.
Begin a new thread in the existing PARMAR chat flow.
Conversation messages use the configured provider
only after PARMAR review and authorization.
No upload dialog is shown: files are not available in this build.
Request is being reviewed by PARMAR.
The request failed. Retry when ready.
Side navigation collapses to an accessible drawer.
Upload is not supported. Network-dependent requests report explicit errors.
No progress state, attachment preview or download is claimed as implemented.
Reduced-motion mode and collapsed navigation remain supported.
Canonical VOKKI art restored; original PARMAR logo crops come from Logo.jpg.

svg.text: PARMAR / DESKTOP REFERENCE BOARD · Design specification, not a flattened application UI
Existing chat, safety, approval, research, memory, settings and status flows only. No fake upload or automation backend.
